name: Player cheats
summary: All 10 player cheats with their codes and unlocks, as printed by the guides on November 26, 2026 (10 of 10 codes published).
body: Cheats only appear after the main story is finished (NoobFeed: all 91 story missions, in Chapter 5), under Progress Menu > Cheats; the tab stays hidden until at least one cheat is unlocked (Push Square). Each cheat must then be unlocked by its own requirement; a code entered before that does nothing. To enter one: press Up on the D-pad to open the phone, hold L1 and press R1 (Xbox: hold LB, press RB); GamesRadar+ and Push Square phrase it as holding both together. Then enter the D-pad sequence; an on-screen notification confirms it. The sequences are identical on PS5 and Xbox Series X|S. Using any cheat disables trophies/achievements and saving for that session; quitting or reloading an earlier save restores them (Push Square, Gamer Tweak, GTABase), and progress made while cheating is lost on quit (GTABase). Gamer Tweak says weather and screen-filter cheats can be switched off by entering the same code again and that the money code can be repeated. There are no phone-number cheats, and there is no PC version or keyboard cheat input yet (Gamer Tweak, GTABase PC page).
$250,000: Up, Right, Down, Left, Up, Left, Down, Right; finish the story. Does: Instantly gives you $250,000.
Drunk: Up, Left, Right, Up, Up, Left, Right, Up, Left, Right; spend $2,500 on alcohol. Does: Instantly makes you and your partner drunk.
Raise Heat Level: Left, Down, Right, Down, Up, Down, Up; lose a 3-star wanted level 25 times. Does: Raises your heat level across the map.
Raise Wanted Level: Left, Down, Right, Down, Up, Right, Up; lose a 3-star wanted level 50 times. Does: Raises your wanted level across the map.
Unlimited Focus: Down, Up, Up, Down, Up, Down, Up, Down, Up, Right; finish the story. Does: Your Focus never runs out.
No Fall Damage: Down, Up, Up, Up, Up, Up, Up, Up, Down; survive a freefall from 40 feet 20 times (printed only by GTABase and Game-Checklists so far). Does: Makes you immune to fall damage.

Parachute: Right, Up, Left, Up, Right, Up, Left, Up, Right; complete 50 skydives or BASE jumps from 300 feet or higher (printed only by GTABase and Game-Checklists so far). Does: Adds a parachute to your loadout.
Body Armor: Down, Up, Left, Up, Up, Up, Up, Up, Down, Down; complete 100 workouts. Does: Adds body armor to your loadout.

Repair Vehicle: Right, Down, Down, Right, Down, Right, Right, Down; get 1st place in 10 races at Gellhorn Raceway, Thrillbilly Mud Club and Boone Speedway (printed only by GTABase and Game-Checklists so far). Does: Fully repairs the vehicle you're in.

Unlimited Nitrous: Right, Down, Down, Right, Down, Right, Right, Left; complete 50 Stunt Jumps (printed only by GTABase and Game-Checklists so far). Does: Your vehicle never runs out of nitrous or fuel.
Disagreement on Raise Heat Level: PC Gamer prints the code but shows the unlock as ???.

Disagreement on No Fall Damage: Code printed only by GTABase (PS5 and Xbox pages, updated November 24) and Game-Checklists (updated November 24); GamesRadar+, PC Gamer, Gamer Tweak, Push Square and GTA Vice Guides still list it as not found.

Disagreement on Parachute: Code printed only by GTABase (PS5 and Xbox pages, updated November 24) and Game-Checklists (updated November 24); GamesRadar+, PC Gamer, Gamer Tweak, Push Square and GTA Vice Guides still list it as not found.

Disagreement on Repair Vehicle: A search-engine summary attributed an Up, Down, Down code to GamesRadar+, but the GamesRadar+ page itself (updated November 22) shows TBC, so that summary was wrong. Code printed only by GTABase (PS5 and Xbox pages, updated November 24) and Game-Checklists (updated November 24); GamesRadar+, PC Gamer, Gamer Tweak, Push Square and GTA Vice Guides still list it as not found.

Disagreement on Unlimited Nitrous: Code printed only by GTABase (PS5 and Xbox pages, updated November 24) and Game-Checklists (updated November 24); GamesRadar+, PC Gamer, Gamer Tweak, Push Square and GTA Vice Guides still list it as not found.

name: Combat challenges
summary: The exact requirement for each of the ten Combat challenges, with the cheat rewards tied to finishing five and all ten.
body: PowerPyx and DayOne both list ten Combat challenges; the requirements below are as those two guides give them, in the order shown.
Speed Kills: kill 3 enemies in under 30 seconds.
Melee Combat: kill or knock out 5 enemies in a row with melee weapons without dying.
Explosive Combat: kill or injure 3 enemies with one explosive.
Headshots: kill 4 enemies with headshots in a single use of combat focus.
Drive-Bys: kill 5 enemies by drive-by in under 1 minute without leaving the vehicle.
Stealth Sniping: kill 7 unalerted enemies with a scoped sniper rifle without dying or being arrested.
Incendiary: kill or injure 5 enemies with fire in under 15 seconds.
Revolver Headshots: kill 6 enemies with revolver headshots without reloading or switching weapons.
Long-Range Sniping: kill 3 enemies in under 10 seconds with a scoped sniper rifle from 300 feet.
High Explosive: kill or injure 8 enemies with explosives in under 20 seconds without taking damage.

Neither guide lists a reward for a single challenge; per the cheat lists from PowerPyx, DayOne, Press Start and Game Rant, finishing 5 Combat challenges unlocks the Speeder 700 GT spawn cheat and finishing all 10 unlocks the Bravado Banshee spawn cheat.
PowerPyx says all challenges are open from the start, that any 50 earn the One Last Thing trophy and that 70 of the 80 count for the completion checklist.

name: Criminal challenges
summary: The exact requirement for each of the ten Criminal challenges, with the cheat rewards tied to finishing five and all ten.
body: PowerPyx and DayOne both list ten Criminal challenges; the requirements below are as those two guides give them, in the order shown.
Mugging: rob 5 pedestrians.
Stick Ups: rob 3 stores in a day without dying or being arrested.
Carjacking: carjack 3 vehicles and take them to a Pay 'n' Spray in a day without dying or being arrested.
Mugging Spree: steal $500 in cash from pedestrians in a day without dying or being arrested.
Cop Car Theft: keep a wanted level for 5 minutes in a stolen law enforcement motor vehicle.
Cop Weapon Theft: steal a weapon from the trunk of 5 different law enforcement vehicles without dying or being arrested.
Stick Up Spree: rob 2 stores in each of the 5 counties in under 20 minutes without dying or being arrested.
Cop Tow: tow an occupied law enforcement vehicle for 1 mile without stopping.
Carjacking Spree: register or respray stolen vehicles from 10 different manufacturers at a Pay 'n' Spray in under 30 minutes without dying or being arrested.
Carjacking Pro: earn $100,000 selling stolen vehicles to any fence or Pay 'n' Spray in a day without dying or being arrested.

Neither guide lists a reward for a single challenge; per the cheat lists from PowerPyx, DayOne, Press Start and Game Rant, finishing 5 Criminal challenges unlocks the Maibatsu Sanchez spawn cheat and finishing all 10 unlocks the Western Zombie Bobber spawn cheat.
PowerPyx says all challenges are open from the start, that any 50 earn the One Last Thing trophy and that 70 of the 80 count for the completion checklist.

name: Exploration challenges
summary: The exact requirement for each of the ten Exploration challenges, with the cheat rewards tied to finishing five and all ten.
body: PowerPyx and DayOne both list ten Exploration challenges; the requirements below are as those two guides give them, in the order shown.
WAiNK Locations: scan any 4 landmarks, curiosities or sculptures with WAiNK.
Skyscrapers: climb to the highest point of the 5 tallest skyscrapers in Vice-Dale County.
Collectible Cards: find 3 collectible cards in each of the 5 counties.
Encyclopedia: discover 100 animals, vehicles and weapons.
Underwater Discoveries: locate and explore any 25 unusual sights on the ocean floor.
Rail Tour: ride a train for 1 mile in each of the 5 counties in a day without skipping.
Underwater Treasures: find 85 underwater treasures.
Black Hole Wrecks: find all 11 black hole wrecks.
Road Trip: drive to every city and town in Leonida in a day without leaving the vehicle except to refuel.
Helipad Flyovers: fly over all 41 Vice City and Vice Beach helipads at 100 feet or lower in under 10 minutes.
DayOne words Black Hole Wrecks as 11 ocean black hole wrecks; otherwise the two lists match.

Neither guide lists a reward for a single challenge; per the cheat lists from PowerPyx, DayOne, Press Start and Game Rant, finishing 5 Exploration challenges unlocks the Nagasaki Sea Sparrow spawn cheat and finishing all 10 unlocks the Nagasaki Carbon RS spawn cheat.
PowerPyx says all challenges are open from the start, that any 50 earn the One Last Thing trophy and that 70 of the 80 count for the completion checklist.

name: Fitness challenges
summary: The exact requirement for each of the ten Fitness challenges, with the cheat rewards tied to finishing five and all ten.
body: PowerPyx and DayOne both list ten Fitness challenges; the requirements below are as those two guides give them, in the order shown.
Gym Member: become a member at any gym.
Foot Travel: travel 5 miles on foot in a day.
Pro Cyclist: cycle 15 miles in a day.
Pro Swimmer: swim 3 miles in a day.
Balanced Workout: complete a workout on each type of gym equipment in a day.
Strength Regime: hold Strength Level 4 with Jason and Lucia at the same time for 5 consecutive days.
Cardio Regime: hold Cardio Level 4 with Jason and Lucia at the same time for 5 consecutive days.
Waning Sands Run: go on foot from the gate of The Tip pier to Waning Sands in under 13 minutes without taking damage.
Tequesta Swim: swim from Tequesta Retreat to Starfish Island in under 15 minutes.
Southwind Cycle: ride a bicycle from Williams Guest House in Grayson to Chicky's Tiki Bar in Southwind in under 22 minutes without falling off.

Neither guide lists a reward for a single challenge; per the cheat lists from PowerPyx, DayOne, Press Start and Game Rant, finishing 5 Fitness challenges unlocks the Tuff BMX spawn cheat and finishing all 10 unlocks the '65 Vapid Dominator spawn cheat.
PowerPyx says all challenges are open from the start, that any 50 earn the One Last Thing trophy and that 70 of the 80 count for the completion checklist.
IGN names the Strength challenge Muscle Regime and words it as keeping Muscle Level 4 on both leads at once for 5 consecutive days.
IGN's wording of Waning Sands Run, from The Tip pier gate to Waning Sands on foot in under 13 minutes, has no condition about taking damage.

name: Shopping challenges
summary: The exact requirement for each of the ten Shopping challenges, with the cheat rewards tied to finishing five and all ten.
body: PowerPyx and DayOne both list ten Shopping challenges; the requirements below are as those two guides give them, in the order shown.
Vehicle Modder: make 5 modifications to your vehicle at a mod shop.
Grocery Shopper: spend over $250 at convenience or liquor stores in a day.
Well Armed: buy 3 sidearms and 3 longarms from Ammu-Nation.
Well Groomed: spend over $1,000 at barbershops, hairdressers or salons.
Stylishly Armed: buy cosmetic upgrades for 5 sidearms and 5 longarms at Ammu-Nation.
Well Dressed: spend over $5,000 on clothing.
Custom Ride: spend over $20,000 in a single mod shop visit.
Heavily Armed: spend over $50,000 at Ammu-Nation stores.
Serious Modder: spend over $125,000 at mod shops.
Nest Egg: bank $1,500,000 in your BuckMe checking account.
DayOne's table runs Grocery Shopper and Well Armed together in one row, so it shows nine separate rows for this group.

Neither guide lists a reward for a single challenge; per the cheat lists from PowerPyx, DayOne, Press Start and Game Rant, finishing 5 Shopping challenges unlocks the Maibatsu Boomazoom spawn cheat and finishing all 10 unlocks the Truffade Thrax spawn cheat.
PowerPyx says all challenges are open from the start, that any 50 earn the One Last Thing trophy and that 70 of the 80 count for the completion checklist.
IGN calls this category High Roller Challenges; its ten requirements match the ones listed here.
IGN says all 80 challenges sit in 8 categories and at least 70 are needed for 100 percent completion and The Long Road trophy.

summary: The exact requirement for each of the ten Sports challenges, with the cheat rewards tied to finishing five and all ten.
body: PowerPyx and DayOne both list ten Sports challenges; the requirements below are as those two guides give them, in the order shown.
Basketball Rookie: score at 3 different hoops in a day.
Golf Rookie: play 18 holes at King Gator or Frontier Adventure Golf in under 30 minutes, finishing 3 under par or better.
Basketball Streak: make 10 basketball shots in a row in under 2 minutes.
Pool Streak: win a game of pool at 3 different locations in a day without losing or quitting.
Basketball Tour: score a basketball shot in every county.
Golf Pro: play 18 holes at both King Gator and Frontier Adventure Golf in a day, finishing at par or better.
Triple Bank: bank the cue ball off 3 rails before potting a shot.
Basketball Pro: score at all 100 hoops in Leonida.
8-Ball Break: win a game of pool by sinking the 8-ball on the break.
Double Hole In One: get two holes in one in a row in a single game at King Gator or Frontier Adventure Golf.
DayOne's wording for Basketball Tour says every country where PowerPyx says every county.

Neither guide lists a reward for a single challenge; per the cheat lists from PowerPyx, DayOne, Press Start and Game Rant, finishing 5 Sports challenges unlocks the Vapid Stanier G2 Taxi spawn cheat and finishing all 10 unlocks the Brimstone Golfer spawn cheat.
PowerPyx says all challenges are open from the start, that any 50 earn the One Last Thing trophy and that 70 of the 80 count for the completion checklist.

name: Vehicle challenges
summary: The exact requirement for each of the ten Vehicle challenges, with the cheat rewards tied to finishing five and all ten.
body: PowerPyx and DayOne both list ten Vehicle challenges; the requirements below are as those two guides give them, in the order shown.
Vehicle Discovery: examine or discover 6 different vehicles.
Wheelie: hold a wheelie for 0.25 miles.
Winning Streak: take 1st place in any 3 races using a muscle car, a sports car and a supercar.
Throttled: hold a speed of over 100 mph in a motor vehicle (duration disputed, see below).
Drawbridge Jump: jump a vehicle more than 100 feet over a drawbridge 3 times without leaving the vehicle.
Top Speed: reach 175 mph in a car, truck or on a motorcycle.
Train Landing: touch down a flying airplane on a moving train without destroying it.
Oceanarium Jump: jump from an aircraft at 0.5 miles or higher and parachute into the orca or dolphin tank at the Vice City Oceanarium without dying.
Rally Winner: win 3 races in a row in a single day at Thrillbilly Mud Club, Gellhorn International Raceway and Boone Speedway without quitting or restarting.
Train Jump: jump a motorcycle 75 feet or more and land on a moving train twice in 20 minutes.
The two guides differ on Throttled: PowerPyx says to hold over 100 mph in a motor vehicle for 2 minutes, DayOne says for 2 miles.

Neither guide lists a reward for a single challenge; per the cheat lists from PowerPyx, DayOne, Press Start and Game Rant, finishing 5 Vehicle challenges unlocks the Lapwing Mallard spawn cheat and finishing all 10 unlocks the Progen Emerus spawn cheat.
PowerPyx says all challenges are open from the start, that any 50 earn the One Last Thing trophy and that 70 of the 80 count for the completion checklist.
IGN's challenge list gives Throttled as holding over 100 mph in a motor vehicle for 2 miles, agreeing with DayOne rather than PowerPyx's 2 minutes.

name: Small banks, branch by branch
summary: PowerPyx's list of the 14 small banks by county and district with the take it gives for each.
body: PowerPyx numbers the 14 small banks in map order and gives a take range for each; no other guide read lists them.
Mariana County: Fleeca in Key Lento ($5,000 to $20,000), Shorefront in Watson Bay ($5,000 to $20,000) and Gibson Brothers Bank ($10,000 to $30,000).

Vice-Dale County: Lombank in Peacock Bay ($5,000 to $20,000), Fleeca in Peacock Bay ($5,000 to $20,000), Shorefront in Downtown ($5,000 to $15,000), Shorefront in Rockridge ($5,000 to $20,000), Lombank in Bayside ($15,000 to $45,000), Fleeca in Washington Beach ($10,000 to $30,000), Lombank in Ocean Beach ($15,000 to $45,000), Fleeca in Ocean Beach ($5,000 to $15,000) and Shorefront in Ocean Beach ($5,000 to $15,000).
Leonard County: Druthers State Bank ($15,000 to $45,000). Kelly County: Shorefront in Ambrosia ($5,000 to $15,000).
PowerPyx says each small bank has a cash drawer and a safe, and both must be emptied for the job to count.
PowerPyx does not say what guards each branch; Eurogamer says hovering over a robbery on the map shows its take value and security level, and calls banks the hardest places to rob.

name: Bank vaults, branch by branch
summary: PowerPyx's list of the eight large banks with vaults and the take it gives for each.
body: PowerPyx lists eight large banks, each with a vault, a cash drawer and a safe; no other guide read lists them.
Fleeca at VCIA ($100,000 to $150,000), Fleeca in Tequesta ($65,000 to $110,000), Lombank in Downtown ($135,000 to $205,000) and Fleeca in Downtown ($100,000 to $150,000).
Four are in Ocean Beach: a Lombank ($135,000 to $205,000), a Fleeca ($75,000 to $135,000), a second Lombank ($75,000 to $135,000) and a Shorefront ($95,000 to $140,000).
PowerPyx says the vault only opens while a security guard from an armored van carries a cash briefcase inside, and that robbing one brings a four-star wanted level at once.
PowerPyx gives no further detail on guards at individual branches.

name: Payday loan stores, one by one
summary: PowerPyx's list of the seven payday loan stores by district with the take it gives for each.
body: PowerPyx numbers the seven stores and gives a take range for each; no other guide read lists them.

Vice-Dale County: Quick Buck in Hamlet ($5,000 to $15,000), Payline Loans 247 ($5,000 to $15,000), Payday Loans Store in Southside ($5,000 to $15,000), Payday Loans Store in Little Cuba ($15,000 to $25,000), Payday Loans Store in Rockridge ($5,000 to $15,000) and Quick Buck in La Perle ($5,000 to $15,000).
Kelly County: Cash Flow ($2,000 to $10,000).
PowerPyx describes a teller at the counter and a safe in a back room, and says nothing about guards.

name: Gang operations, gang by gang
summary: The named gang operations in PowerPyx's numbered list, set beside the areas DayOne gives for each gang.
body: PowerPyx numbers the 39 operations in the order of the in-game menu and had named 22 of them, with 32 found, when read on November 18, 2026; unvisited sites show only as Robbery Opportunity.
Kingfishers (3): Fishing Shacks, Sunrise RV Park and Manatee Motel. DayOne says all three are around what it calls the Grasslands.
Kolts & Associates (5): Kingpin Bowling, June Warehouse, La Cascara Motel, Brooks Boatworks and one unnamed. DayOne, which spells the gang Kolt and Associates, places all five around Port Gellhorn.
M7 (2): M7 Compound and one unnamed. DayOne places one in Hamlet and one in the far north near the mountain.
La Polilla Negra (2): Palmer Fishing Warehouse and one not yet found. DayOne places both just north-west of what it calls the Grasslands.
Final Chapter (4): Farm Fix Meth Lab, Irons Building Supply, one unnamed and one not yet found. DayOne places them mainly around Ambrosia.
San4San (5): Sound4Sond Studio (PowerPyx's spelling), JanJak's Garage and three unnamed. DayOne places all five in the northern part of Vice City.
PTT Youngin$ (2): both unnamed, plus an Ultimate Edition site that PowerPyx says the game's gang menu does not count. DayOne places both in the middle-west of Vice City.
The Guardia Brothers (3): Casa Guardia and two unnamed. DayOne places them around Little Cuba.

Other criminals (13): Exotic Animals Front, Slator Towing Inc, Chatfield Storage & Logistics, Leonida Carrier Warehouse, Cigar Import Front, Gas Station Meth Front, Backroom Weed Front, Carter Mining Boathouse and five not yet found.
PowerPyx says each site's map icon shows how many key valuables it holds, usually weapon variants, luxury watches and a cash safe; neither guide gives a cash figure or a guard count for any site.
